name: clawd
description: Clawd, a little crab above your prompt that reacts to what Claude is doing

utc_offset.title: UTC offset
utc_offset.description: Your time zone as an offset from UTC, for example +05:30. Clawd uses it for the sun, the moon and the time of day

leave_at.title: Leave time
leave_at.description: Optional. When you leave work on weekdays, as HH:MM in 24-hour time. Clawd counts down to it and tells you to go home. Empty turns it off

break_every.title: Break every
break_every.description: Minutes of work before Clawd suggests a break, for example 50. Empty or 0 turns it off

lastfm_user.title: Songbook: Last.fm user
lastfm_user.description: Optional. Your Last.fm username. With the API key, Clawd sings from what you played recently. Costs one Last.fm lookup and one small Haiku call per day

lastfm_api_key.title: Songbook: Last.fm API key
lastfm_api_key.description: Optional. A read-only Last.fm API key from last.fm/api/accounts. Claude Code keeps it in secure storage

lyrics.title: Songbook: lyrics
lyrics.description: Where the songbook's real lines come from. lrclib looks your Last.fm songs up on lrclib.net, a free lyrics database (only titles and artists are sent); off has Claude Haiku write from what it knows

songbook_effort.title: Songbook: effort
songbook_effort.description: How hard Claude Haiku thinks about the day's songbook. Higher writes better lines and uses more tokens: about 2,000 for low, 4,000 for medium, 8,000 for high, once a day

talk.title: Claude can talk to Clawd
talk.description: On lets Claude use the clawd tool to make Clawd act, sing or say how it is. It adds about 400 tokens to each request. Off by default
